Navratri is here, and it's time to make your vrat meals delicious, exciting and full of variety!
Wondering what to cook during the nine days of Navratri? This video brings you 9 delicious vrat recipes featuring traditional fasting ingredients, with a mix of crispy snacks, savoury favourites and sweet treats.
Here’s what you’ll discover:
Vrat Ke Dahi Vade
Farali Bhajiya
Vrat Ki Singhada Barfi
Farali Sama Vada
Suranacha Kees
